messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: REGION ALERT: primary-us-central GPU utilization 96% sustained (3m). Request queue x4 baseline. Autoscaler failing to create new nodes: API error QUOTA_LIMIT_REACHED. Paging @samantha and @raj.ops :mega:

samantha: seeing the alert, joining. pulling autoscaler logs and recent scaling events.

raj.ops: confirmed. cloud returned 403 quota cap on GPUs for the project in us-central. current=199, limit=200. there's also a rate-limit on instance creations (create_per_minute). some instance creations are stuck at "initializing" for >4m due to driver module deadlock.

theo: which customers are impacted? can we spill traffic to us-west2 quickly?

support-liz: NovaPay (enterprise platinum) complaining about timeouts on streaming chat and empty responses on generate. They started at 10:12 UTC.

samantha: immediate plan: 1) stop all noncritical batch jobs in us-central (research-batch, nightly-embedding), 2) manual spillover configuration for revenue-critical routes -> us-west2, 3) request emergency quota bump, 4) apply driver hotfix to speed instance init. I'll coordinate.

raj.ops: I'll start evicting research pools to free GPUs. Doing a graceful drain on `research-batch-2` and `night-embeds`. Expect to free ~60 GPUs within 2-3 minutes.

oncall-bot: reminder: upcoming handoff in 12m to theo. Pagerduty page triggered to theo.

theo: acknowledged page. contacting cloud provider for quota emergency. Opening escalation ticket CLD-998432.

samantha: configuring selective spillover for critical routes only. Using temporary routing policy:
```
POST /v1/routing/override
{
  "selector": "customer:NovaPay OR tag:platinum",
  "targets": [{"region":"us-west2","weight":0.6},{"region":"us-central","weight":0.4}]
}
```

theo: canary applied to 10% of NovaPay traffic -> us-west2. initial success: requests succeed but latency +120ms.

support-liz: NovaPay reports error rate dropped from 22% -> 6% in the canary cohort. They're seeing degraded but usable responses.

raj.ops: eviction of research pools completed, freed 58 GPUs. autoscaler retried; some new nodes still failing due to image pull timeout on a subset. I'm restarting the node bootstrap controller.

samantha: applying runtime fallback for model `redwood-large` -> `redwood-large-int8` where latency-sensitive and Gold/Platinum customers only. This should reduce GPU mem pressure and allow more concurrent slots.

theo: cloud replied: can provision +50 GPUs if we accept temporary regional quota increase; we must confirm usage and set up automated shrink later. ETA 10-15m after acceptance.

raj.ops: driver hotfix pushed to bootstrap image; instance initialization times dropping. now warm pools coming back online.

support-liz: NovaPay confirms spike of 504s subsided; latency still slightly elevated but within SLA for now.

oncall-bot: handoff: theo accepted the followups. Pagerduty acknowledged by theo at 3786543600.

theo: accepted quota increase. cloud scheduled +50 GPUs to us-central. autoscaler starting additional nodes and rebalancing workloads.

samantha: gradually moving NovaPay back to primary-us-central in 20% steps. monitoring token throughput and queue length.

raj.ops: autoscaler notes: backfill and pod placement complete. queue length trending to baseline. observed a residual 90s periodic spike from internal nightly scheduler — we've disabled the burst window until postmortem.

support-liz: NovaPay happy; their operations team will keep monitoring tonight. reported revenue-impact window ~15 minutes during worst of spike.

samantha: incident scope: primary-us-central region hit hard quota + instance init issues -> autoscaler unable to scale fast enough -> queue growth -> customer impact for NovaPay. Mitigations: emergency quota, evict noncritical batch, selective spillover, model-int8 fallback, driver bootstrap fix.

samantha: owners for postmortem: raj.ops (infra + autoscaler), theo (cloud escalation + quota automation), dev-runtime (model fallback validation), support-liz (customer comms). Deliverables: writeup with timeline, add automated quota alerting, tuning autoscaler create-rate backoff, policy to auto-spill revenue-critical traffic when region utilization >90%.

pagerduty: incident acknowledged and page closed by theo at 3786543998. Incident marked mitigated but not resolved.

samantha: leaving thread open for 24h for any regressions. thumbs up all. :white_check_mark:
summary: Primary-us-central GPU region hit hard quota boundary and had instance init failures; autoscaler creation rate and quota limits prevented fast scale up. Team evicted batch jobs, applied model-int8 fallback for high-value customers, spilled NovaPay traffic to us-west2, accepted emergency +50 GPU quota. Driver bootstrap fix reduced init time. Postmortem assigned and action items created.
